title: 第8章修复术第9章 风灵月影
slug: 法师之上第366章五环法师
content_zh:
穿过狭长且幽暗的走廊，视线豁然开朗，光线也变得明媚。
药香扑面而来，映入眼帘的是一片生机勃勃的绿，让高德感觉身上的腐朽味仿佛都被驱散了许多。
这片占地面积不算特别大的药草种植区，却分布着数种土质不相同的地块。
因为草药这种东西，本质就是极为娇贵的“花草”，需要悉心照料。
不同的草药对生长环境的要求各不相同，有的甚至是极为极端。
而气温、水质这些外部环境不提，单单是不同草药对土壤环境的要求就十分复杂。
大多数草药在疏松肥沃，排水良好的土壤中就能生长。
但有些草药喜生长在含腐殖质丰富的森林腐殖土中，典型就是参类药材。
也有草药喜在酸性或微酸性土壤中生长或喜在河边沙滩上生长。
因此，要根据草药本身的生长习性和特性，因地制宜，选择适宜的土壤种植。
草药的培育工作是门深奥的学科，不止是要对药材能做到辨认以及对其的习性了如指掌，还要知道如何根据药材的习性，构造适合其生长的环境，从而保证药材的存活率，以及增加产量与提升药性。
这些工作包括但不限于“营养土”的配置、间苗、定苗、深耕结合施肥促进土壤物理性状的改善、中耕培土除草、施肥、灌溉浇水、病、虫害防治、株形调整.......
高德早上工作的大头就是中耕培土、施肥浇水以及检查病虫害。
一般情况下，这些工作在熟练之后，就是简单的重复性工作。
因为塞达法师所种植的药草品类都是固定的。
所以即使高德是第一次上手这些工作，但依照前身留下的记忆，他还是很干脆利落且不出任何差错的完成了药材的培育工作。
做完这些，他早上的工作也就剩最后一项了。
高德步伐匆匆，来到一个小房间。
房间里摆放着许多个铁笼子，每个铁笼子里都有五到十只不等，通体皮毛灰褐色的老鼠。
这些是塞达法师专门饲养繁育，用作药剂**实验的小灰鼠。

人体试药虽然得出的结果是最为准确，但即使这个世界人命没有那么宝贵，也绝对没有到可以让塞达法师肆无忌惮地拿活人试药的程度，大部分情况下还是以动物试药为主。
小灰鼠繁殖能力强，饲养成本低，攻击性相对较差，并且在这些前提下，与人类相似度较高——指的是基因上的相似度，不是外表。
于是乎，小灰鼠理所当然地成为了最佳的**试验对象。
高德给每个铁笼里的饲料盆倒入一些饲料，顺便装满水，然后检查了一遍笼中所有的小灰鼠状态，发现其中一只小灰鼠显得病恹恹的，甚至没有活力去抢食。
再仔细观察了一下，高德发现这只小灰鼠的背部宛如“斑秃”一般，一小块毛皮完全脱落，露出里面的皮肤，略显通红。
“看来是得了什么皮肤病，”高德做出判断，点了点头，“那就是你了。”
他将这只得病的小灰鼠从铁笼里拎了出来。
当然，高德不是要给它治病。
一是不会，二是也没这个必要。
由于小灰鼠远不如药材值钱的原因，对于小灰鼠的饲养，药园里的学徒们并不像对待药材那般上心，所以也时不时有些小灰鼠会患病。
这些患病的小灰鼠最终的结局只有一个，就是“及早发现，人道处决”，免得将病传染给其它健康的小灰鼠。
高德也没有客气，抓住这只小灰鼠的脑袋，顺着脖子方向用力一拧，随着一声清脆的啪嗒声，小灰鼠连挣扎都没能挣扎一下，就没了声息。
将死去的小灰鼠顺手扔到一旁，高德注意力却是放在了自己的脑海中。
在他的脑海深处，一块精美巧妙的月牙宝石，此刻正在绽放灵光。
一些变化已经发生：在宝石的内部，赫然是出现了两个光点以及十二条虚线，组成了两个北斗七星式的漏勺图。
每组漏勺图，都有七个点位与六条虚线，但此刻都只有起点位置的点位在闪烁，剩余六个点位则是黯淡的。
不难推断出，七个点位全部点亮之后才算圆满。
下一瞬，熟悉的信息界面浮现于高德的“眼前”。
本源：
0环——【人类】（17）、【灰眼鼠】（17）

法术：
0环——【法师之手】、【修复术】
......
相比之前，本源信息栏上，又多出了一个词条：【灰眼鼠】。
content_en:
After passing through the long, dark corridor, the vision suddenly opened up and the light became brighter.
The aroma of medicine hit his face, and what he saw was a patch of vibrant green, which made Gothe feel as if the smell of decay in his body had been dissipated a lot.
This medicinal herb cultivation area is not particularly large, but it is dotted with several plots of land with different soil quality.
Because herbal medicines are essentially extremely delicate "flowers and plants" that require careful care.
Different herbs have different requirements for the growing environment, and some are even extremely extreme.
Not to mention the external environment such as temperature and water quality, the requirements of different herbs on the soil environment are very complex.
Most herbs grow well in loose, fertile, well-drained soil.
However, some medicinal herbs like to grow in forest humus soil rich in humus, a typical example is ginseng medicinal herbs.
There are also herbs that like to grow in acidic or slightly acidic soil or on river beaches.
Therefore, suitable soil for planting should be selected according to the growth habits and characteristics of the herbs themselves and local conditions.
The cultivation of herbal medicines is a profound subject. It requires not only the identification of medicinal materials and a thorough understanding of their habits, but also how to construct an environment suitable for their growth according to the habits of the medicinal materials, thereby ensuring the survival rate of the medicinal materials, increasing the yield and improving the medicinal properties.
These tasks include but are not limited to the configuration of "nutrient soil", thinning, stabilizing seedlings, deep plowing combined with fertilization to improve soil physical properties, cultivating soil and weeding, fertilizing, irrigation and watering, disease and pest control, plant shape adjustment...
The bulk of Gaode's morning work is cultivating the soil, fertilizing and watering, and checking for pests and diseases.
Under normal circumstances, these tasks are simple repetitive tasks after you are proficient.
Because the types of medicinal herbs grown by Master Seda are fixed.
So even though it was the first time for Gaode to start these tasks, according to the memory left by his predecessor, he still completed the cultivation of medicinal materials quickly and without any mistakes.
After doing this, there was only one last thing left for him to do in the morning.
Gothe walked hurriedly and came to a small room.
There are many iron cages placed in the room, each containing five to ten rats with gray-brown fur.
These are small squirrels specially raised and bred by Master Seda for use in pharmaceutical experiments.
Although the results of human drug testing are the most accurate, even if human life is not so precious in this world, it is definitely not to the extent that Master Seda can test drugs on living people unscrupulously. In most cases, animals are still used to test drugs.
Gray rats have strong reproductive capacity, low feeding costs, and relatively low aggressiveness. Under these conditions, they are highly similar to humans—referring to genetic similarities, not appearance.
Therefore, the little squirrel naturally became the best experimental subject.
Gaode poured some feed into the feed basin in each iron cage, filled it with water, and then checked the status of all the little squirrels in the cage. He found that one of the little squirrels looked sick and did not even have the energy to grab food.
After closer inspection, Gothe discovered that the little squirrel's back looked like "bald area". A small piece of fur had completely fallen off, revealing the skin inside, which was slightly red.
"It seems that he has some kind of skin disease," Gothe made a judgment and nodded, "That's you."
He took the sick little squirrel out of the cage.
Of course, Gaode is not trying to cure it.
First, no, and second, there is no need.
Since small squirrels are far less valuable than medicinal materials, the apprentices in the medicine garden are not as concerned with raising small squirrels as they are with medicinal materials, so some small squirrels will get sick from time to time.
There is only one final outcome for these sick little squirrels, which is "early detection and humane execution" to avoid spreading the disease to other healthy people.little squirrel.
Gothe was not polite. He grabbed the little squirrel's head and twisted it hard along the neck. With a crisp snap, the little squirrel didn't even struggle, and then it became silent.
Throwing the dead little squirrel aside, Gothe focused on his own mind.
In the depths of his mind, an exquisite and ingenious crescent moon gemstone was blooming with spiritual light at this moment.
Some changes have already occurred: inside the gem, two light spots and twelve dotted lines suddenly appeared, forming two Big Dipper-style colander images.
Each set of colander charts has seven points and six dotted lines, but at this moment only the starting point is flashing, and the remaining six points are dim.
It is not difficult to infer that it is complete only when all seven points are lit.
The next moment, a familiar information interface appeared in front of Gaode's "eyes".
Origin:
Ring 0 - [Human] (17), [Grey-eyed Rat] (17)
Spells:
Level 0 - [Mage's Hand], [Repair]
...
Compared with before, there is another entry on the source information column: [Grey-eyed Mouse].
